subject: Interim rider & evidence handoff for SOC 2 post-report gap
messages:
From: Rachel Connors <rachel.connors@carepoint.health>
To: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: stefan.martin@carepoint.health
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: interim rider and evidence inventory to cover post-report window

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this. As we discussed with Veridus during intake, our procurement team needs a short-form continuity rider (commonly called a "post-period rider") to cover the period between Redwood's last SOC 2 Type II report (report period ended 2022-12-31) and today. The legal team wants a signed assertion that the control environment described in the report has been maintained or that compensating controls were in place for any deviations.

Concretely, can you provide:
- A one-page rider/endorsement we can attach to our review packet (PDF or DocuSign-ready).
- An evidence index that maps the SOC 2 controls to a small set of artifacts we can request (logs, policy versions, change-control tickets, KMS rotation notes).
- Confirmation of any material control changes since 2023-01-01 and whether they were covered by the report's monitoring.

We are on a compressed timeline: Veridus needs the rider + evidence index by COB Monday (2028-03-13) to meet our board review. If you prefer, Kimberly from Redwood's compliance ops can coordinate directly with our security-ops (Stefan copied).

Thanks — looking for a simple affirmative statement where possible; we can follow up for attachments.

— Rachel
Rachel Connors
Senior Risk Manager, Carepoint Health
Rachel.Connors@carepoint.health

Attachments: none referenced in first request

From: markus.klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Connors <rachel.connons@carepoint.health>, stefan.martin@carepoint.health
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: interim rider and evidence inventory to cover post-report window

Rachel —

Appreciate the clear scope. We can produce a short continuity rider plus an evidence index that maps to the core Trust Services Criteria covered in our 2022 Type II report. Quick notes:
- We typically draft a one-page rider that reiterates the report period, states the assertion window (e.g., 2023-01-01 through 2028-03-01), and calls out no material control failures discovered in that interval or notes compensating controls where applicable.
- Kimberly will lead the evidence index and pull the artifacts; I’ve looped her in.
- There are a couple of configuration changes in 2026 (KV cache persistence handling and a rolling update to our KMS integrations). Those are documented — we’ll highlight them and include compensating monitoring evidence.

Kimberly/Priyom — can you draft the rider and assemble the index as a spreadsheet. For this packet we should include:
  * control-to-artifact mapping (columnized)
  * sample access logs (anonymized CSV)
  * change-control tickets for the two KMS related changes
  * pointer to SOC 2 report PDF (we'll attach)

Timing: Rachel asked for COB Mon 2028-03-13. If we can deliver an initial draft by EOD Sun (2028-03-12) that gives her team time to route it, that would be ideal.

Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: none (will follow from compliance ops)

From: kimberly.park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: markus.klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Connors <rachel.connons@carepoint.health>
Cc: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, audit@veridus.com
Date: Sat, 10 Mar 2028 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: interim rider and evidence inventory to cover post-report window

Hi all —

Uploading the first pass of the artifacts list and a short rider draft. I attached an evidence index spreadsheet (rider-evidence-index-20280309.xlsx) and a PDF copy of our 2022 Type II report for reference. A couple of implementation notes up front:
- Assertion window proposed: 2023-01-01 through 2028-03-01 (we avoid claiming to the current live date to account for immediate-day operational drift). If Carepoint needs the rider to run through 2028-03-11 we can extend, but we prefer the 03-01 cut to match our internal sampling window.
- Material changes: two KMS workflow updates (2026-05 and 2026-09) — included change-control ticket IDs and monitoring alerts as evidence rows 14–18 in the spreadsheet. No gaps were identified in retention or access governance.
- Artifacts provided (sample): SOC2_TypeII_20221231.pdf, access-log-sample-2028Q1.csv (anonymized), change-control-kms-202605.pdf, change-control-kms-202609.pdf.

I’ve redacted PII in logs and annotated the index to make verifier review quicker (column "recommended request" suggests which files to include for Veridus).

Next steps:
1) Markus — can you review the rider language in the sheet and confirm signatory routing? I can convert to DocuSign.
2) Rachel/Stefan — let me know if Veridus needs additional artifacts (e.g., vulnerability scan copies or specific PKI rotation logs). We can add one-off exports.

Draft rider text (excerpt):
"Redwood Inference hereby affirms that, based on a review of operational records and change-control artifacts, the control environment as described in the SOC 2 Type II report (period ended 2022-12-31) has been maintained for the period 2023-01-01 through 2028-03-01, except as noted in the attached evidence index."

I’ll attach the spreadsheet and a PDF sample in a follow-up with the DocuSign-ready rider.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Compliance Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Attachments (referenced): rider-evidence-index-20280309.xlsx; SOC2_TypeII_20221231.pdf; access-log-sample-2028Q1.csv

From: Rachel Connors <rachel.connons@carepoint.health>
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: stefan.martin@carepoint.health, audit@veridus.com
Date: Sun, 11 Mar 2028 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: interim rider and evidence inventory to cover post-report window

Kimberly / Markus —

This is great, thanks for the fast turnaround. The proposed 2023-01-01 through 2028-03-01 window is fine for our packet; legal prefers a conservative date rather than a rolling "today" claim. We reviewed the evidence index and flagged two items Veridus asked to see before signing off:
- The KMS rotation log excerpt for the 2026-05 update (redacted is fine).
- A short note confirming whether any authz roles were changed for the service account used by backups in 2026.

If you can add those two artifacts to the index and send the DocuSign-ready rider PDF, we can route to procurement and Veridus Monday morning.

Appreciate the clear mapping — will follow up if Veridus needs anything else.

Regards,
Rachel

Attachments: none (requesting two small artifacts)
